text: This report reviews and recommends approval of the application to amend the Official Plan and Zoning By-law to permit a two tower mixed-use building at 90-110 Eglinton Avenue East at 58-storeys each. The towers are connected at floors 5 to 10 with a bridge element. The proposed building contains 1,035 residential units, with a total gross floor area of 93,096.6 square metres, including 1,305.2 square metres of at-grade retail. The proposal includes 2,375 square metres of publicly accessible space, which includes a 24.1 metre-wide landscaped mid-block connection with a minimum 3.0 metre-wide publicly accessible pedestrian walkway that will connect Eglinton Avenue East with a planned walkway through to Roehampton Avenue.
